wp: WP3 - truth-oriented corrections (leaderboard-only; never scored as proxy improvements)

3a_start_state.rest_voltage: per anchor j and cell: the last sample before the anchor charge starts (row s-1 of the segment)
3a_start_state.r_j: events.tail_margin_Ah(CK0 reference discharge, {cell: rest voltage}) = upper bound of the charge left at the start (max over cells); half-bound variant r_j / 2
3a_start_state.exit: if max_j |r_j - r_0| < 0.1 Ah (upper-bound version): WP3a 'no material effect', stop 3a
3a_start_state.correction: otherwise Q'_fc,j = Q_fc,j + (r_j - r_0) applied to the visible anchor table before any model runs (causal: r_j uses only that anchor's own pre-charge voltages and the CK0 curve)

3b_eps_drift: Q' = Q + d * max(0, 100.41 - Q), d = -0.031 (main), sensitivities -0.020 and -0.035

3c_path_effect.verification: for each anchor j and each of the six step variants: P1 = first program with t_cv_end >= t_end_j - 10 min, P2 = next program in the same segment; offset_j = step(P1) - step(P2) - median of later consecutive differences in that segment (trend-adjusted). Verified if the median trend-adjusted offset over anchors lies in [0.2, 0.7] Ah in >= 5 of 6 variants
3c_path_effect.inputs_affected: list which model inputs contain P1 programs: SUB fallback (M4: steps after the latest anchor, first vs last), SUB phase (45 C month-end steps), SUB sqrt branch (anchors only), S gap endpoints (45 C steps of the uncovered month)
3c_path_effect.SUB_3c: in SUB's fallback branch drop P1 of the latest anchor; with the remaining steps s' (>= 2), Q = base + (s'_last - s'_first) + rate * (t(s'_first) - t(P1)), rate = Theil-Sen slope of s' if >= 3 points else the two-point slope; with < 2 remaining steps keep the original. Other branches unchanged

combined: 3a (if not exited) + 3c (if verified) + 3b main, applied in that order
outputs: leaderboard-only SOH tables (submitted configuration eps0 + 0.4, main step) for each base model x {base, 3a, 3a_half, 3b (3 d values), 3c, combined}; WP1 hypothesis-grid scores with these variants added (decision table and regret table); real-proxy numbers are shown only as the h = (Delta 0.4, f 0, d 0) column of the grid
exposure: 3c changes SUB at CK1 and CK3 (fallback), whose proxy errors are known; it is therefore leaderboard-only and labelled exposed

amendment_1.when: 2026-10-16, after the 3a/3c audits (wp3_audits.json, no model metric) and before any WP3 evaluation
amendment_1.reason: audit shows anchor 0 rested only 0.5 h at 45 C before charging while anchors 1-7 rested 2 h at 25 C, so r_0 is not comparable; the submitted model already bridges 45 -> 25 C through eps0 + 0.4 relative to anchor 1
amendment_1.added_variant: 3a_ref1: Q'_fc,j = Q_fc,j + (r_j - r_1) for anchors j >= 1, anchor 0 unchanged; plus its half-bound version 3a_ref1_half. The registered main 3a (reference r_0) is kept and reported
amendment_1.combined_variants: combined (3a main + 3c + 3b) and combined_ref1 (3a_ref1 + 3c + 3b) are both reported
